build_k_hop_subgraph: build a k-hop subgraph extractor that computes nodes and edges around a central node in a PyTorch graph
build_make_graph: build a NetworkX directed graph from raw concept triplets with optional pruning of unconnected nodes
build_prepare_embeddings: build node embeddings from GloVe or Word2Vec files with multi-word averaging fallback for graph nodes
build_graph_network_module: build a GraphNetworkModule that loads a knowledge graph, prepares node features, and runs GCN forward passes
build_graph_network: build a multi-layer GCN/RGCN/SAGE graph network with configurable conv layers, batch norm, and dropout
